_note: Bank-specific roles for the Barclays section. Each role is mapped to a SOC 2020 unit group using the ONS SOC 2020 coding index (Volume 2), which lists the exact job title under that code. Exposure and employment are then pulled from the main occupations dataset so every number on the bank chart shares one methodology. 'barclays_context' quotes what Barclays itself said about where the cuts fall, with the source URL in barclays_facts.json.

roles.note: ONS codes 'Bank teller', 'Bank cashier' and 'Telephone banking adviser' to 4123 Bank and post office clerks.
ONS codes 'Call centre agent' and 'Fraud adviser' (call centre) to 7211.
ONS codes 'Mortgage administrator', 'Mortgage assistant' and financial processing clerks to 4129 Financial administrative occupations n.e.c.
ONS codes 'Fraud analyst', 'Fraud inspector' and 'Fraud strategy analyst' to 3319 Protective service associate professionals n.e.c.
ONS codes 'Mortgage adviser', 'Financial adviser' and 'Wealth manager' to 2422 Finance and investment analysts and advisers.
ONS codes 'Bank manager' and 'Branch manager (bank)' to 1131 Financial managers and directors.
